essence: Multiple classes of deities are collectively invoked to take part in the consecration.
Personified auspicious qualities and lunar goddesses are included in the consecration.
The full spectrum of time divisions and their rulers is invoked in the consecration.
Primordial maternal figures are explicitly included among the consecrating powers.
The assembled auspicious groups, including hosts of apsarases, are commanded to consecrate the recipient.
